Sandbox_MinidoracatNB_PopupMode_tooltip: Choose when the notice board opens automatically after joining the game.
Sandbox_MinidoracatNB_PollIntervalSecond: Real-time seconds between checks for changed notice files on the authority side.
Sandbox_MinidoracatNB_DefaultLanguage_to: Translate language code whose directory acts as the shared baseline: every file in it that is NOT marked `.only` shows up for players of all languages, and a player's own language overrides same-named files. The code is also the folder name under NoticeBoard/. This is a fixed list of the codes the mod accepts, not a scan of the folders you actually created — check the server log line 'notice languages=' or the in-game Language menu for that.
Sandbox_MinidoracatNB_NotifySound: Play a sound for new notices
Sandbox_MinidoracatNB_NotifySound_toolti: Play a short mod-provided chime when a new or updated notice arrives, alongside the on-screen toast. One sound per batch, never one per notice. The chime ships with the mod and plays outside Project Zomboid's sound banks, so the game's sound volume slider does not affect it. Players have their own switch and volume slider under Options → MODS; this option is the server-wide master switch.
Sandbox_MinidoracatNB_MaxImageKB_tooltip: Largest single PNG the server will sync from NoticeBoard/images/. Default 512 KB. Raising it increases every player's sync time proportionally, so raise it only if you really need to. The image count and total size limits still apply on top of this.
Sandbox_MinidoracatNB_MaxImageCount_tool: How many PNG files the server syncs from NoticeBoard/images/. Default 20. Files are sorted by name and the ones past the limit are skipped and logged as img-count. Raising it increases the amount every player has to download proportionally, and the first join takes longer.
Sandbox_MinidoracatNB_MaxImageTotalKB_to: Combined size of all synced images. Default 4096 KB (4 MB). Images past the limit are skipped and logged as img-total. Raising it increases the amount every player has to download proportionally: at the maximum of 16384 KB the first join spends a few minutes syncing in the background. Players keep their own cache write limit, which no server setting can raise.
